name: Congress Trail
why: A paved loop in the Giant Forest from General Sherman, the largest tree on Earth, to the giant sequoias of the Senate and House groups.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. Summer shuttle from the Giant Forest Museum; the upper Sherman Tree parking is off Wolverton Road. In 2026 a section is being rebuilt: the short inner loop is walked there and back.
water: Water at the Sherman Tree parking.
dangers: Snow and ice in winter: chains on the road.
Black bears: never leave food in the car.

points.name: Sherman Tree trailhead
points.note: The upper parking off Wolverton Road.

points.name: General Sherman Tree
points.note: The largest living tree by volume, about 2,200 years old.

points.name: Senate Group
points.note: A cluster of giant sequoias in a meadow.
